title: Blockgame Resourcepacks Helper
description: A Fabric mod for PirateSoftware's Blockgame to assist resourcepacks in interacting with Blockgame items!
body:
# Blockgame Resourcepacks Helper

_**Blockgame has announced that they will be moving over to Hytale in the near future, thus making this mod obsolete. This mod is now Archived.**_

A mod for Blockgame that enables resourcepacks to interact with the item data of Blockgame items.

> _This mod uses the same Minecraft version required by the Blockgame server._

> **This is an unofficial mod for Blockgame and is not affiliated with the Blockgame team.**

## How to use

### For end users
Install this mod along with any compatible resourcepack and voilà - it's that easy.

### For resourcepack creators
You want to make your own resourcepack for Blockgame? This mod will help you achieve just that.

The technical documentation for resourcepack creators can be found in the [Blockgame wiki](https://blockgame.piratesoftware.wiki/wiki/Blockgame_Resourcepacks_Helper).

## Requirements

The following are required to run this mod:
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)

In addition, the following mods are recommended:
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
